title: Flatness and an adically formally smooth closed fibre imply adic formal smoothness
statement: Let $f:(A,\mathfrak m_A)\to(B,\mathfrak m_B)$ be a local homomorphism of Noetherian local rings [def-weil-pbc-noetherian-ring]. Let $k=A/\mathfrak m_A$ and $\overline B=B/\mathfrak m_AB$, with maximal ideal $\overline{\mathfrak m}=\mathfrak m_B/\mathfrak m_AB$ and its induced $k$-algebra structure [def-weil-pbc-algebra-hom-quotient]. Assume $f$ is flat [def-weil-pbc-flat-ring-map] and $\overline B$ is formally smooth over $k$ for the $\overline{\mathfrak m}$-adic topology [def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic]. Then $B$ is formally smooth over $A$ for the $\mathfrak m_B$-adic topology.

source.place: More on Algebra, Tag 07NQ, proposition-fs-flat-fibre-fs, implication (2) => (3). The fibre B tensor_A k is its canonical quotient B/m_A B. Definition 07NI is the equivalent condition (2)(b) of Tag 07EC (lemma-formally-smooth), namely the discrete-base definition used in def-weil-pbc-formally-smooth-adic.

proof.text: Use flat_adicCompletion_of_flat_local to obtain ψ:Ahat→Bhat, commuting with the canonical maps and flat. Install Noetherianity of both completions. The maximal ideals are extensions of the original maximal ideals; Ideal.map_map and the commutation equality prove ψ is local. Both rings are complete by the maximal-ideal completion instance.
Apply formallySmoothAdic_closedFiber_completion to transport the original formally smooth closed fibre to the completed map. This separately proved comparison does not assume flatness.
Apply formallySmoothAdic_of_flat_closedFiber_complete to the completed flat local map and its formally smooth closed fibre.

The private formallySmoothAdic_of_completion proves the reverse completion reduction. Given J²=0 and g:B→D/J killing m_B^k, locality and scalar compatibility show the structure map α:A→D sends m_A^k into J. Ideal.le_comap_mul shows α kills m_A^(k+k). Extend α through A/m_A^(k+k) using eval_A and extend g through B/m_B^k using eval_B. The kernel of each eval is the corresponding power of the completed maximal ideal, proved by completion_eval_ker using pow_smul_top_eq_ker_eval. Approximate each element of Ahat modulo power k+k by cA(a). Locality of ψ sends its difference into m_Bhat^(k+k), hence into m_Bhat^k, so both maps to D/J agree on the completed source. They give a genuine Ahat-algebra lifting problem. Apply formal smoothness of the completed map, and restrict the lift along cB. The commutation ψcA=cBf proves scalar compatibility over A; the quotient identity restricted along cB is the original g. All of this glue is written and checked in Lean, with no new hole.
